name: croc_jaw_closeup
description: Close-up of a saltwater crocodile's snout, side view facing right: front half of the head, jaws closed, interlocking teeth along a wavy jaw line, yellow slit-pupil eye under a heavy brow at the left edge (-300,-150), nostril bump at the snout tip, scale outlines, and many tiny dark #2a2a20 dome pressure receptor dots over the jaw scales, densest along the jaw edges. Anchor centre; bbox x -460..450, y -192..175.
